worked.problem: From external point P, tangents PA and PB touch a circle with centre O. If OP = 5 cm and OA = 3 cm, calculate both tangent lengths.
actions: Join O to point of contact A. Radius OA = 3 cm is perpendicular to tangent PA.
Right triangle OAP has hypotenuse OP = 5 cm and leg OA = 3 cm.
Apply Pythagoras: PA² = OP² − OA² = 25 − 9 = 16 cm².
The positive tangent length PA = 4 cm. Tangents from the same external point are equal.
Answer: PA = PB = 4 cm. Check: 3² + 4² = 5².
